_what: T17/T20 demo spec, FOUR arms: d-walkrun (face=true run turns to the travel direction; movement only), d-control (default-OFF, zero influence), d-noface (face=false steering/movement decoupling), d-actions (STATIC action-class arm: place + use-block + equip judged on world state and slot contents; no !agent relay). DISCIPLINE (T20/D2): (1) a face=true arm must NOT carry a pose op -- pose pins yaw and its settle loop fights the action layer's turn; place A with 'command tp @s x y z ~ <pitch>' (checker inv12); (2) shots must be taken INSIDE the motion window (spaced wait_ticks), otherwise the "run" images are all identical post-stop frames; (3) use target=eat needs an edible item selected first (hotbar slot 2 = apple); (4) act verb=place / use target=block need explicit x/y/z plus the in-band block probes (checker inv10); (5) equip needs a declared slot-level transition (checker inv11); (6) exactly ONE displacement threshold is declared (checker inv12a).

_judgment.moved: walkrun/noface: dump pos differs from A by >=3.0 blocks on the target axis (SINGLE declared displacement threshold -- the old '>=4' contradicted _judgment.thresholds and is deleted, not relaxed); log has AGENT sprint confirm ... attempted=true effective(tick-end)=true and AGENT dir self-check with the matching combo
_judgment.default_off: control: stays at A within 0.01 blocks and its log slice has no RELAY agent line except the explicit !agent stop
_judgment.restore: after postRelay !agent stop the inputs are cleared and setSprinting(false) (log: RELAY agent -> agent=off (inputs restored, sprint cleared))
_judgment.decoupling: noface: yRot stays 180.00 for the whole window while x advances (steering and movement are independent)
_judgment.pose_discipline: A face=true (!agent goto ... run, no face=false) arm MUST NOT carry a pose op: pose always pins yaw+pitch (TicketBridge doPose requires x/y/z/yaw/pitch) and its settle loop then waits for a yaw the action layer overwrites -> 'settle timeout want yaw=180.00 but yaw=-90.00' (B4). Place A with {"op":"command","line":"tp @s x y z ~ <pitch>"} (yaw untouched) instead. face=false arms keep their pose on purpose (the decoupling arm must hold yaw=180). Enforced by checker inv12.
_judgment.thresholds: T18-D3 calibration, declared ONCE: displacement >=3.0 blocks (5.2-block target, 3.7 observed in the 0.75s window), arrival residual <=0.25 (AgentInput.ARRIVE_R=0.35; measured 0.13). Do NOT set a threshold that can never pass, and do NOT declare a second conflicting number anywhere in this spec (checker inv12a).
_judgment.default_off_criterion: Default-OFF is judged ONLY by two identical state pos readings plus the absence of RELAY agent lines. PNG identity is NOT a criterion: HUD/held-item animation makes control run1/2/3 differ.
_judgment.display_gate: Driver locates images by <shotPrefix>-N, so ticket shot names are <prefix>-1/-2/-3 (inv9), and the driver only accepts PNGs whose mtime is >= arm start (stale same-named PNGs are ignored, not matched as a fake green).
_judgment.place_criterion: act verb=place must report ok AND the world must change. Target cell = 2003,121,10 (the cell one block INSIDE the quartz room's +z wall at z=11; basis: (1) ScenePresets PLATFORM = smooth_stone 1990,120,-10..2010,120,10 so 2003,120,10 is the solid support, (2) the 'wall' preset fills stone_bricks only at z=0, so y=121,z=10 is not a preset block, (3) D5 receipt proved 2003,121,11 = quartz_block i.e. the wall face is at z=11). The ticket DECLARES the basis in-band: a pre-probe 'execute if block 2003 121 10 minecraft:air' (rc=1) before the op and a post-probe 'execute if block 2003 121 10 minecraft:stone_bricks' (rc=1) after it (checker inv10). The receipt must also carry blockBefore=minecraft:air, blockAfter=minecraft:stone_bricks, supportAfter=minecraft:smooth_stone. ok=True alone is NOT the criterion.
_judgment.use_block_criterion: use target=block on the platform top (2003,120,9, face defaults UP) must reach tier=place AND the world must change at the declared probe cell 2003,121,9: pre-probe '... minecraft:air' (rc=1) before, post-probe '... minecraft:stone_bricks' (rc=1) after (checker inv10, via the op's _probe_cell). A receipt without a world-state readback is not a pass.
_judgment.equip_criterion: inv action=equip slot=<head|chest|legs|feet> moves an armor piece between backpack 0-35 and the vanilla armor slot 36-39. Criterion = a SLOT-LEVEL observable transition, never a same-item swap: the d-actions ticket first installs armor38=diamond_chestplatex1 and hotbar.1=leather_chestplatex1 ('item replace'), then the swap must move the leather into armor38 and the displaced diamond into s1 => state.armor 8 -> 3 (not 8 -> 8) and both slot contents change. The op declares _expect_armor_before/_expect_armor_after AND _expect_slot_source/_expect_slot_armor (both pairs must differ; checker inv11). RECEIPT-FIELD OBLIGATION: the receipt must literally contain armorBefore=<before> and armorAfter=<after> (exposed on the success path by TicketBridge.pumpInv 'confirm'); an ok=true receipt without those fields is NOT accepted as evidence.
_judgment.sampling_window: state samples sit inside the motion window (t~2 and t~26 after A is set) because the relay starts the walk before the ticket runs; a sample taken after the walk finishes cannot show displacement.

_discipline._why: D7 (pre-reviewer P2-6): the prose promises in _what / arm desc are turned into machine checks. world_mutation_arm_last = the arm whose ticket mutates world state must be the session's LAST arm (d-actions runs LAST so place/use-block/equip cannot touch the movement arms). assert_after_world_mutation = a ticket that mutates the world must carry a runtime assert op (an assert-free ticket is judged by prose only). Removing this block while the prose still promises 'runs LAST' is itself a spec-level FAIL.

_prereq: Window 1280x800; client restarted after compileJava syncShaderPack (T17 added AgentInput + AgentInputMixin + the !agent relay knob). Run tools\check-synth-spec.ps1 first (T17 spec has no synth/paired arms: it only checks the tickets parse).
scoped: window 1280x800 / dev save test / scene wall / start A = wall_front(2000.0,121.5,8.0,yaw180,pitch5) / target B ~5 blocks away / single client / T17 action layer (default OFF)

arms.desc: face=true (run default): !agent goto 2005.2 121.0 8.0 run -> turns to the travel direction + sprint; A set via command tp (yaw untouched); 3 shots inside the motion window; eat (slot 2); movement only (action ops moved to d-actions)

STATIC action-class arm (no !agent relay, runs LAST so its world mutations cannot touch the movement arms): place (2003,121,10) + use target=block (2003,120,9) each bracketed by in-band 'execute if block' probes, and an equip round that installs a NON-identical chest piece so the swap is observable (armor 8 -> 3, s1 leather -> diamond)
